column1: # 核心界面：按钮、标签、状态、内网接口配置、告警

column2: 使用我的全局告警设置

column1: A response slower than this is DEGRADED — up, but not well. Turn on latency alerts under Alerts to hear about it.
column2: 响应慢于此值即为「性能下降」：服务还在，但状态不好。在「告警」里开启延迟告警后才会收到提醒。

column1: Every element has to match. One mismatch marks the whole monitor down, and the alert names the first thing that broke.
column2: 所有元素都必须匹配。任一不符即判定该监控故障，告警会指出第一处出错的元素。

column1: Go back a step and capture at least one element first.
column2: 请返回上一步，先抓取至少一个元素。

column1: No custom headers. Nightbell always sends a descriptive User-Agent.
column2: 暂无自定义请求头。Nightbell 始终会发送带有说明信息的 User-Agent。

column1: Checks try id → CSS → XPath → text fingerprint, in that order, so small markup changes won't false-alarm.
column2: 检查按 id → CSS → XPath → 文本指纹的顺序尝试，页面结构的小改动不会误报。

column1: This URL is http, and \"Follow redirects\" is on, so the server can send the check to https and its certificate will be judged by this setting.
column2: 此 URL 是 http，且已开启「跟随重定向」，服务端可能把检查重定向到 https，此时证书会按本设置判定。

column1: Pick the kind of check. You can change everything later.
column2: 选择检查类型，之后随时可以修改。

column1: It may have been deleted from another screen.
column2: 它可能已在其他页面被删除。

column1: No checks recorded yet. Run one now to start the history.
column2: 暂无检查记录，立即运行一次即可开始记录。

column1: The monitor stays down until it recovers. Acknowledging only stops the repeats for this outage. The next one will shout again.
column2: 监控会一直保持故障状态直到恢复。确认只是停止本次故障的重复提醒，下次故障仍会告警。

column1: Add a check on this host
Every client that verifies certificates is refusing this connection. A check that still passes is checking something that stopped being trustworthy.
column2: 所有校验证书的客户端都在拒绝此连接。若检查仍然通过，说明它检查的对象已经不再可信。
